title: Implications of Converting Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit into Light Rail Transit
what_it_is: Implications of Converting Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit into Light Rail Transit

sections.label: RTS Link agreements and LRT system
sections.summary: Three agreements were signed to resume the RTS Link Project, which will use an LRT system and start passenger service by end 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Three agreements were signed to give effect to the resumption of the project – an agreement to amend the RTS Link Bilateral Agreement, a Joint Venture Agreement between Singapore’s SMRT and Malaysia’s Prasarana to constitute a joint venture Operating Company or OpCo, and a Concession Agreement for the Government of Malaysia and LTA to appoint this OpCo as the RTS Link Operator for the first 30-year concession period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Both sides have agreed that the RTS Link will use an LRT system, instead of the Thomson-East Coast Line or TEL MRT system.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The LRT system for the RTS Link is more similar to a medium capacity MRT system, such as the Jurong Region Line, with a peak hour capacity of 10,000 passengers per hour per direction.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The change from TEL to LRT system will not require any major changes to the original infrastructure design.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The RTS Link station continues to be located next to the TEL Woodlands North Station to provide commuters with ease of transfer.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Singapore looks forward to working closely with Malaysia to implement the RTS Link Project and to commence passenger service by end 2026.

sections.label: Safeguards in RTS Link agreement
sections.summary: The RTS Link agreement contains safeguards to protect both countries' interests and ensure the project's objectives can still be achieved.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And that is what we did with the RTS Link Project.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: But the important thing is this – there are safeguards in the agreement to protect the interests of both countries and to ensure that the objectives of the project can still be achieved.

sections.label: Shared interest in reliable trains
sections.summary: Both countries share an interest in ensuring trains run reliably and safely and meet commuters' needs from both sides.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Both countries will have a shared interest to ensure that the trains are able to run reliably, safely and meet the needs of commuters from both sides.
